text:
sara: Heads-up — enterprise customer reported sharp p99 latency increase ~03:10 UTC, app traces show requests routing to eu-west from us-west causing extra 220-320ms. Customer says no config changes on their side. :warning:

alex: Copy. Any error patterns? 502/504s or auth failures?

sara: Initial logs show a batch of 502s from the us-west region health probe between 03:09:50–03:10:20, then the routing controller moved traffic to eu-west as fallback. Billing spike for cross-region egress also flagged.

mike: Do we have the region-healthcheck logs? I can pull from the agent bundle.

deploy-bot: region-healthcheck/us-west probe-agent restarted at 2024-04-14T03:10:07Z (auto-restart by watchdog).

alex: That restart might've caused a transient 502. Our failover policy is configured to fail fast (single-probe) for VIPs with high-availability. Looks like one probe = mark DOWN => instant routing change.

jen: Oof, we intentionally tightened that threshold last month for fast failover. Could be too sensitive for noisy probes.

sara: Customer transcript: "We saw 3x latency and billed extra for cross-region calls, this started at 03:10 and lasted ~4m". They want root cause and compensation.

alex: Repro steps I'm trying locally: curl health endpoint with simulated 502s then watch routing decision.

alex: Snippet of probe log around the window:
```
[2024-04-14T03:09:58Z] probe(us-west): GET /_hc -> 200 ok (latency 12ms)
[2024-04-14T03:10:04Z] probe(us-west): GET /_hc -> 502 Bad Gateway (upstream timeout)
[2024-04-14T03:10:07Z] probe-agent(us-west): process restarted (exit 1)
[2024-04-14T03:10:08Z] probe(us-west): GET /_hc -> 502 Bad Gateway
[2024-04-14T03:10:09Z] controller: region us-west marked UNHEALTHY (failure_count=1)
[2024-04-14T03:10:10Z] routing: reroute customer-tenant-42 -> eu-west (policy=fallback_fast)
```

mike: Restart timing + single failure threshold = misclassification. We should require 2 consecutive failures or add short suppression window after agent restart.

jen: Agreed. Short-term mitigation: force route affinity for the affected tenant back to us-west and disable fallback_fast for that tenant until we patch.

sara: Done — I created a temporary route override for tenant-42 to pin to us-west at 03:22 UTC. Customer reports latency returning to baseline.

alex: Proposed long-term fixes:
- revert single-probe failover (policy change) or increase failure_count threshold to 2
- ignore probe results in the first 10s after probe-agent process restart
- add backoff before cross-region routing to avoid immediate egress spikes

jen: Can you open an RFC/PR? We need a perf rubric to ensure failover latency targets still met.

alex: I'll open PR #4221 for controller change (threshold=2) and PR #4222 for agent-restart suppression logic.

mike: Billing: billing-bot — can we calculate the cross-region egress and auto-credit the customer for the window 03:10–03:22?

billing-bot: Found 1.2GB cross-region egress for tenant-42 between 2024-04-14T03:10:00Z and 2024-04-14T03:22:00Z. Estimated charge $4.32. Recommend manual credit.

mike: Please issue a credit and flag account for outreach.

sara: I've messaged the customer with explanation and that we issued a $4.32 credit, and outlined the mitigation and upcoming fixes. They asked for steps so they can reproduce — shared repro checklist.

alex: Repro checklist I shared:
1) Use a test tenant with routing policy fallback_fast.
2) Send two successful healthchecks then inject one 502 and restart probe-agent.
3) Observe controller marking region UNHEALTHY on single failure (before fix).

alex: Also added unit test for controller to require 2 failures before flipping.

jen: Timeline: roll the policy change to prod tomorrow 02:00 UTC canary -> 02:30 -> full. Agent suppression patch targeted for next week.

mike: Postmortem owners: alex (root cause + code fix), sara (customer comms), jen (policy rollout + perf signoff), mike (billing reconciliation).

sara: Leaving notes in the incident tracker: incident-id INC-20240414-1804. Will add logs and exact timestamps. :white_check_mark:

alex: One more thing — add a healthcheck metric for "post-restart failures" so we can alert on noisy agents.

jen: Good call. I'll add an alert with a 5m window to the ops dashboard.

sara: Thanks team. Customer happy with credit and timeline for fixes. Closing thread but keeping notes for the postmortem. :thumbsup:
